# T31K (Timon Wong)

> Timon Wong, known online as T31K, is an indie hacker and solopreneur from Singapore. He runs a business with a portfolio of SaaS products, having built and shipped over 30 apps in the past 2 years, including Dreamchanted, a viral AI image generator acquired by Danny Postma. He is very active on X and an avid writer on Medium, covering indie hacking and software engineering. T31K and Timon Wong are the same person; t31k.com is his personal site.

## About

- [About T31K](https://t31k.com/about): Who Timon Wong is, what he has built, and how to reach him

## Projects

- [Harmonize](https://getharmonize.app): Spotlight-like app for your music on macOS
- [Calorieasy](https://calorieasy.app): Track calories with AI
- [Profile Picture AI](https://profilepicture.ai): AI profile picture generator
- [Yuree AI](https://yureeai.com): AI beauty color analysis
- [YouTube on Loop](https://youtubeonloop.com): Watch YouTube videos on loop
- [Commit Everyday](https://commiteveryday.com): GitHub activity, visualized in cards
- [Dreamchanted](https://dreamchanted.com): Viral AI image generator, acquired by Danny Postma
